lore: {name}: A table where the stars hold still while you choose.
use: Pick your enchantments yourself: three random ones that fit the item, each with a slider from 0 to its maximum, paid from a level budget that the bookshelves around it and the obsidian floor below set (up to 50).
secret: Hold eight Netherite Nuggets in your off hand and strike an Enchanting Table with a Netherite Sledgehammer: it becomes this. Break it and table and nuggets return.

lore: {name}: The Dark Enchanter after it has seen the End; the stars swirl in its cloth.
use: Like the Dark Enchanter, but strength 60 on a whole Nihil Obsidian floor, where Protection and Feather Falling reach V. Blazing Obsidian works only half here.
secret: Eight Enderite Nuggets and an Enderite Sledgehammer turn a Dark Enchanter into it. The anvil still cannot make Protection V; only this table can.
